description: Free: the daily (1d) Ichimoku Cloud trend for a crypto pair (top 200 coins, from Binance.US, Kraken, Gate or MEXC): bullish, bearish or neutral, whether price is above, below or in the cloud, and the tenkan/kijun cross. Limited to 20 calls per hour. For other timeframes and the line values use ichimoku_signal; for six indicators use confluence_signal, for support/resistance and targets price_levels, for every top-200 coin at once market_scan, for ranked trade setups across all coins trade_setups.
